summary: P1 confirmed and fixed red-first; full VM gate green; fractional-depth corpus failures remain zero.
body:
Changed [resolve.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixdepth/crates/interchange/src/scene/resolve.rs:365). The earlier fractional-depth exemption removal remains in [sr_core_corpus.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixdepth/crates/interchange/tests/sr_core_corpus.rs:609); the coordinator’s SAMPLE_REGRESSION changes are preserved. No commits; locks released.

P1 was valid; no findings rejected. The prior fix incorrectly assigned stacking zero to every double-valued z. The XSD defines blackHole z as a geometric double, but the renderer also converts it to an i32 stacking value. Only camera, object3D, particles3D, and ocean are exempt. See [blackHoleType/z](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixdepth/crates/interchange/schema/sr-core/scene-render.xsd:3954) and [renderer stacking](/home/admin/src/scene-render/crates/sr-eval/src/program.rs:1541).

The fix validates finite doubles separately from stacking semantics. blackHole stacking truncates toward zero and saturates to i32 bounds; conversion uses a bounded, nonnegative magnitude. Integer stacking validation remains unchanged. Original depth text survives overlay export/re-import exactly, including blackHole fractions. No values.rs or export.rs change was needed.

Public API unchanged: `pub fn resolve(doc: &SceneDoc<'_>, limits: &ResolveLimits) -> Result<Resolved>`. Private helper: `fn stacking_z(element: &str, value: &str) -> Result<i64>`.

Renderer-derived exemption list and conversion semantics were adapted from `/home/admin/src/scene-render/crates/sr-eval/src/program.rs:1541`; record this source in attribution. Type handling was checked against sr-model’s `build.rs`, `src/parse.rs`, and `src/xsd/simple.rs`.

TDD red → green:

- `scene_black_hole_depth_truncates_and_saturates_stacking`: returned 0 instead of -7 → passes, including fractional and saturation cases.
- `scene_black_hole_depth_keeps_mixed_sibling_order_and_text`: returned `[s, bh]` instead of `[bh, s]` → passes.
- All six focused depth tests pass, including hostile-number rejection and exact overlay retention.
- Earlier round: `scene_corpus_fractional_depth` failed on `"-0.5" is not an integer`; geometric-depth and sibling-order tests failed on `554.256`, and overlay round-trip failed on `-554.2560000000001` → all pass.

VM gate: formatting and clippy passed; **320 tests passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored**; Wasm passed for **51 crates**. [Gate log](/tmp/fixdepth-round1-gate.log), [red log](/tmp/fixdepth-round1-red.log), [green log](/tmp/fixdepth-round1-green.log).

Pinned corpus, 1,343 cases:

| Failure category | Original | Before review fix | After |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| fractional-depth | 11 | 0 | 0 |
| material-override | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| external-expression | 122 | 122 | 122 |
| geodesic-camera | 18 | 18 | 18 |
| voxel-palette | 14 | 14 | 14 |
| linked-audio | 18 | 18 | 18 |
| generated-id | 12 | 12 | 12 |

Before/after this round: **190 failing cases, 244 identical failure records**, 1,698 oracle-validated exports, and 3,396 successful re-imports. No new failure records. The corpus aggregate still exits 101 for those unchanged out-of-scope failures; the full crate gate is green. [Before log](/tmp/fixdepth-round1-before.log), [after log](/tmp/fixdepth-round1-after.log).
